No production account, deploy, push, or publish path was touched.

impact.note: Probe query only, to prove the index answers graph questions. Loop 00 changed no symbol, so no impact analysis was required for its own edits.

detectChanges.interpretation: Correct rather than a tooling miss: all six committed files are Markdown and JSON, so no indexed code symbol was touched. Independently corroborates the ownership audit and the byte-identical build assets.

limitations: Full-text/BM25 search unavailable (LadybugDB FTS extension needs network); vector search unavailable on this platform. Graph traversal works and returns exact results. The roadmap's step-7 sub-requirement that FTS be working is therefore NOT met; the acceptance criterion, which requires only that queries return results, is met.
The bare repository name is ambiguous on this host — three registered repos are named izzi-ai. Every query must pass --repo with the absolute worktree path.
gitnexus analyze rewrites its managed doc blocks in 8 tracked files. W0 reverted all 8 to canonical; only W0 may mutate the index or those blocks.

keyFindingsForConsumers.PQ-01: MUST PORT. eslint.config.mjs (147 lines) plus lint:ci/lint:fix/lint:strict and the root eslint devDependencies exist only on feature/aibase-my-graph-ui-sync. Canonical has ESLint installed but zero config, so the lint gate cannot run at all. Until this lands, no loop may assert a lint warning budget.
keyFindingsForConsumers.PQ-08: CRITICAL GATE. An uncommitted second Personal Office implementation lives in the quarantined dirty worktree: shared/work-model.ts (state machine, canonicalJson, action-hash, WORK_SCHEMA_VERSION=1), shared/work-redaction.ts, 13 modules under main/work/ (~160 KB incl. work-service.ts 31 KB and run-repository.ts 38 KB), five test files, and live wiring already applied to main/db/database.ts, main/index.ts, main/preload.ts and renderer/App.tsx. It is committed nowhere and a git clean destroys it. Loop 01 must reconcile with it rather than author a greenfield model.
keyFindingsForConsumers.PQ-09: agentGateway.ts is on the Loop 01 required-reading list AND is modified-uncommitted in the dirty worktree, so the canonical copy is not the copy in flight. Canonical additionally contains agentGateway-routing.ts plus its test, which the old branch lacks. Diff three ways before treating any version as source of truth.
keyFindingsForConsumers.canonicalIsAhead: Canonical beta.3 is ahead of the old feature branch on every subsystem. Only one file is net-new on the old branch: eslint.config.mjs. Do NOT port the old package.json wholesale — it would revert the izzi-ai rebrand, downgrade desktop 1.14.0-beta.3 to 1.12.0, downgrade axios, loosen exact security pins to carets, and drop the ws/sharp/adm-zip pins.
keyFindingsForConsumers.securityNoteForLoop03Owner: The already-wired work-model migration in database.ts logs and proceeds on error instead of failing closed, justified in-comment only because v1 is purely additive. That justification expires the moment a destructive migration step is added.

canonicalOverride.rationale: The Constitution and orchestration doc are later and more specific, and name the exact commit. The choice is also defensible on evidence: beta.2 is a verified ancestor of beta.3 so nothing is lost; beta.3 carries the Voice Studio hotfix and the exact security pins; and origin/main points at beta.3, so building on beta.2 would fork off the shared line immediately.

beta2ShaApparentConflictResolved.explanation: Both correct. git cat-file -t reports 6db5e993 as type 'tag' — it is the annotated tag OBJECT — while 824e2e5 is the COMMIT it points at (feat(brand): rename desktop app to Izzi AI). No correction required; recorded so a later loop does not 'fix' a non-bug.

installedReferenceVerifiedEmpirically.conclusion: Confirms the two-role split the baseline asserts: beta.2 is the installed reference, beta.3 is the canonical build base.

roadmapReconciliation.thirdWitnessForBF04: worklogs/izzi-current-state.md at canonical records CMR-404 as 'PARTIAL — audit 74 -> 20; ESLint still absent'. Combined with the git ls-tree scan and the ESLint 9 exit-2 failure, the missing lint config is corroborated three independent ways.

roadmapReconciliation.statement: Two roadmap acceptance criteria are unmet. Both are pre-existing conditions of the canonical tree rather than products of this loop, and both are reported rather than presented as green.

residualRisks: BF-01 — no MSVC toolchain on this host, so native better-sqlite3 cannot be compiled or exercised locally. Keep new contracts unit-testable without a live binding; treat CI as authoritative.
BF-02 — one known timeout flake in customer-video-studio-service.test.ts. Do not read it as a regression.
BF-03/BF-04 — the canonical lint gate is non-functional until PQ-01 lands, and the 359 warning ceiling must be re-measured on canonical before being enforced.
The dirty source worktree remains under concurrent write by a session outside W0 control. Any consumer diffing against it must re-snapshot first; a snapshot goes stale within minutes.
